name: AncientGreymon

When this would be played, you may place specified cards from your hand/battle area under it. Each one reduces the play cost.
main_effect:
＜Security A. +1＞ (This Digimon checks 1 additional security card.)

[On Deletion] Return 1 Tamer card and 1 [Hybrid] trait Digimon card from your trash to the hand. Then, you may play 1 Tamer card from your hand without paying the cost.
